answers.core: Because the `FlowContainer` is a core godot class.
answers.workaround:
I think that this is a fairly common setup for a flow container. It would probably be possible to update the `H Separation` and `V Separation` dynamically each frame via script, but it's cumbersome and it's questionable if it can be done with the existing public API of the `FlowContainer` alone.

The only real workaround I can think of is to have every second child be a "spacer" control which is invisible and set to fill & expand. This, however, clutters the scene tree with otherwise useless nodes, and is difficult to deal with when the children are generated dynamically through a script.

title: Add a "space between" layout option to FlowContainer
